definitions.explanation: Describing a man who is good-looking, with refined or attractive features.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ハンサム⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
ハンサム⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧
⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ハンサム⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He was handsome when he was young.

notes:
ハンサム describes a man with refined, attractive facial features. It is a somewhat dated term, less commonly used by younger generations.

USAGE NOTE:
ハンサム is typically used for men only. For women, use ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧, きれい, or ⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧.

MODERN ALTERNATIVES:
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧ is the modern slang for "handsome man" (very common)
- ⟦かっこいい→かっこいい：09378_kakkoii⟧ describes both appearance and general coolness
- ⟦{二枚目|にまいめ}→二枚目：07403_nimaime⟧ is a theatrical term for "leading man type"

ADJECTIVE FORMS:
- ハンサム⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun (attributive)
- ハンサム⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (predicative)
